review_notes: Token glosses on s036-s038 are reverse-distributed across the segments of `הַבַּיְתָה`; the surface, lemma and morphology were read instead, per rule 39.
`מִשָּׁם אָנֹכִי` is read as a verbless clause with a prepositional predicate, so the copula sits on the preposition (rule 49); placing it on `שָׁם` was the competing option.
`יַרְכְּתֵי` → *the farther side* is headed on *farther* by rule 31's subtraction test; *side* is the supplied generic.
